project.description:
Just a funny APES – In APES Gang, team plays an exciting game, has fun, and shills the coin. As Dominic Toretto said, the most important thing is family. APES is more than family; This is APES GANG!
Apes isn’t just a meme coin; it’s a unique utility token with its own farming game, staking pool, fan page where you can join the Gang as a knight, and much more in development. And, of course, an NFT collection with Utility!
Join the APES GANG – shill the coin, play the game, have fun, and stake your tokens!
